shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated pattern across the upper field
vertically stacked registers on a rectangular slab
feather-like/plumed rendering (wing in A, plumed bird/plant form in B)
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry profile-oriented figures in low relief on a tall rectangular field, with a horizontal band of repeated motifs and a small disc somewhere in the field. What is actually depicted differs fundamentally: A shows a single large anthropomorphic winged figure with elaborately detailed beard, hair, garment fringes and a handled vessel, rendered with naturalistic anatomy, whereas B shows an assemblage of schematic silhouetted animals (raptor-like bird, quadruped, long-necked bird) stacked in loose registers beneath a row of U/arch signs, with no dominant human figure and no relationships (holding, touching) comparable to A's.
